values.task_boundary: Deliver the WP-08 birthday-decision contract, complete negative fixture matrix, validator, and retained exact-revision report.
deliverables: Versioned birthday contract and deterministic validator
Disqualifying fixtures for lifecycle lookalikes and every required-evidence omission
Retained focused, negative, and claim-boundary validation report
acceptance_criteria: The WP-08 birth-decision contract accepts one structurally complete candidate and emits stable rejection reasons for every declared lifecycle lookalike or missing evidence surface.
Terminal proof for WP-01/#5817 and WP-02A/#5801 is verified before implementation begins.

Implementation is confined to adl-runtime-kernel/src/birthday.rs, lib.rs module registration, tests/birthday.rs, tests/fixtures/birthday/, the WP-08 feature contract, and .csdlc/evidence/5825/; Runtime v2 is excluded.
Focused and negative validation is deterministic, reproducible, retained under .csdlc/evidence/5825/, and bound to the exact reviewed revision.
Missing or contradictory evidence, private or absolute paths, and personhood, consciousness, citizenship, governance, migration, or public-launch overclaims fail closed.
One bounded exact-head SRP review records no unresolved actionable findings.
The implementation PR targets the intended base and includes Closes #5825 without claiming completion of downstream Birthday work.
The exact birthday nextest target runs at least one test with --no-tests=fail, and native macOS/Linux receipts bind the same fixture digest before portability is claimed.
non_goals: Implementing identity, continuity, Memory Palace, capability, ACP, witnesses, or the integrated review packet
Legal personhood, consciousness, production citizenship, constitutional governance, migration, or public launch claims
Rewriting retained v0.91.x evidence or treating planning prose as birth proof
